markup.message: <button> has only an icon in it and no name: no text, and no aria-label, aria-labelledby or title. A screen reader announces it as "button" without saying what it does. Give it an aria-label, or a text in an element with the class lt-sr-only.

fix.title: Give it a name with aria-label
